title: Countable coproducts imply idempotent completeness
statement: Let C be a pretriangulated category with zero object, integer shifts, additive shifts, and countable coproducts. Then `IsIdempotentComplete C`.

source.place: Lemma 13.4.14, coproduct assertion, using Lemma 12.4.3 and Lemma 13.4.12

proof.text: Construct the telescope endomorphism from an idempotent and its complementary idempotent on a countable coproduct. Its explicit inverse makes it split mono. Complete it to a distinguished triangle; exactness and the split-mono criterion force the third morphism to vanish and provide a split epi. The resulting kernel/cokernel data gives the required splitting of the original idempotent.

source.place: Lemma 13.4.14, coproduct assertion; explicit telescope proof from Lemmas 12.4.3 and 13.4.12
